transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning all. First thing, hip bracket, we need 3 by 10/22 for Tolerance stack check: Hip pitch mounting bracket. That one's on the CMM list!!

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok, thats the one with the tight bore right? i have the gauge pins ready

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: also knee pulley, we need 5 by 10/6, is it worth expediting that one?? the dyno test depends on it

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: *depends on it, sorry. the pulleys we have are the old ones

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: I'd say yes but let's check with the buyer on what it costs. Carlos, what do we have in stock that could cover a gap?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Honestly nothing that fits. I'll look in the bins again but I don't think so.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Can we run a shorter test with the old pulleys? It wouldn't give the full picture, but we'd learn something.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: maybe. the old ones have more wear on the groove, i dont trust the numbers

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: No. Wait for the new ones.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: one pallet came in for the hardware crib, signing for it now

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Luis, did the load frame get its calibration sticker?

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: yea the cal guy came yesterday, sticker is on, cert is in the folder

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: *yesterday afternoon. he was 2 hrs late tho

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Assembly status, finished the left leg sub, right one is waiting for tomorrow 🙏 One connector is giving me trouble 😬

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Which connector? Show me after. If it's the latch again I have a fix.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Will do! 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: On life test, sample two is at about half. I noticed a small amount of backlash growing, but it's not out of spec yet.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Watch it. If it crosses the line, stop and tell me right away.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: the thermocouple amp is acting up again, i think the ground, ill look at it thurs, no today after lunch

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Anything else? No? Good, thanks.
